Metadata.title: Andry · The Odyssey
Metadata.description: Portfolio of Andry, Lead Front-End Developer (React/TypeScript) and business analyst, based in Madagascar.

embarcadere.chapter: Pinax no. 1 · hung at 18°55′S, Ithaca by way of Antananarivo
embarcadere.line: Welcome aboard. The crossing costs one obol… we'll settle up on arrival.

courant.narration: He set out from a red island with a laptop under his arm and one question: how do you build what people actually need?
courant.line: Our traveller hails from a red island. He codes, he listens, and he doesn't get seasick. Well, almost.

rive1.title: Two patron deities
rive1.narration: On the first shore, two deities fought over his talent.
rive1.line: First shore. Two deities are fighting over his talent. Pick your side, I won't tell.

forge.title: Hephaestus's arsenal
forge.narration: In the forge, every skill became a legendary weapon, painted on a workshop plate.
forge.line: Hephaestus's forge. Don't touch anything, it's all still hot. Hover over the plates: the weapons wake up.

escales.title: The journey
escales.narration: Before arriving here, he had dropped anchor in several ports.
escales.line: The ports where he dropped anchor. I've kept the ticket for every crossing, just in case.

delphes.title: Words of oracles
delphes.narration: At Delphi, the oracle was consulted about him.
delphes.line: Delphi. The oracle only speaks to those who've read this far.

hermes.title: Write to Andry
hermes.narration: At the end of the river, a messenger was waiting, sandals already flapping.
hermes.line: To write to him, Hermes takes over. I row, he flies. Each to his own trade.

elysee.narration: And so the traveller found his next team. Perhaps yours.
elysee.line: Last stop: the Elysian Fields. Right, you owe me an obol. Just kidding. Half kidding.

TrialModal.line: Take your time, the boat will wait. The obol meter, however, is running.
